summary: Ray, an operative who says he is an assassin rather than a cop, is questioned over beer and a meal by Becker, who insists Ray is the lead on an investigation and that his qualifications are outstanding. Becker presses Ray to reveal what happened outside Ba'dai, pointing to a service record report full of gaps. Ray reveals that he was never allowed to see the official report and was never asked to file one, despite being the only survivor of his squad.
one_line: In a tense lunch, Ray, an operative insisting he is not a cop, is pressed by Becker to reveal what happened outside Ba'dai.
key_facts: Ray says he is not a cop and describes himself as an assassin who spends much of his time trying to kill people who consider themselves outside the law.
Ray says his job is to authenticate assigned targets from higher-ups and carry out the hit, while finding criminals requires intelligence far beyond his share.
Becker says "You're CIU" and Ray replies that he is not in the investigations division.
Becker says Ray's test scores, mission debriefings and post-incident reports mark him as a smart guy.
Ray has twice as many decorations as any man in the room, according to Becker.
Becker tells Ray "You are the lead on this investigation, plain and simple."
Becker asks Ray to tell him what happened outside Ba'dai, something more revelatory than the official report in Ray's service record.
The official report on the Ba'dai incident in Ray's service record has more gaps than facts, according to Becker.
Becker would not discuss these matters at the crime scene.
Ray says they never let him see the official report on the incident.
Ray is the only one from his squad who made it out of the incident.
Ray says no one ever asked him to file a report on the incident.
Becker wipes his mouth with a pale linen napkin and covers his plate with it.
Ray has lost his appetite and struggles to keep his beer down while Becker eats a forkful of dripping beef.

entities.name: Ray

entities.name: Becker
entities.role: man who presses Ray to reveal what happened outside Ba'dai and insists Ray is the lead on the investigation

entities.name: CIU

entities.name: Ba'dai
